articles.title: Bipartisan lawmakers cook up ‘Hot Rotisserie Chicken Act’
articles.mainIdea: Bipartisan lawmakers cook up ‘Hot Rotisserie Chicken Act’
articles.summary: USA TODAY: Bipartisan lawmakers cook up ‘Hot Rotisserie Chicken Act’. The group of lawmakers from both sides of the aisle have joined forces to broaden access to a beloved grocery store staple.

articles.summary: Benzinga: Snap Announces CFO Exit Days After Job Cuts In A Bid To Improve Profitability— Insider Doug Hott To Take Over. On Monday, Snap Inc. CEO Evan Spiegel announced the departure of Chief Financial Officer Derek Andersen after nearly eight years with the company. Doug Hott, who has served ​as the Snapchat owner’s ​vice president of finance, ⁠strategy, and corporate development, will succeed Andersen, Spiegel said. CFO Exit Comes Days After Layoffs Andersen will participate in his final earnings call on May 6, with his last day set for May 8, according to Spiegel’s internal memo. articles.title: Snap Map’s new ‘Place Loyalty’ badges will show the spots you visit most often
articles.mainIdea: Snap Map’s new ‘Place Loyalty’ badges will show the spots you visit most often
articles.summary: TechCrunch: Snap Map’s new ‘Place Loyalty’ badges will show the spots you visit most often. If you’re in the top 25% of users who visit a certain place, you’ll see your ranking on the Snap Map and can choose to share it with others.
